phase_1_bench_validation.objective: Skull/scalp phantom with known catheter positions. Measure: position error, detection probability, false localization, sensitivity to anatomy/orientation/frequency/exposure.
phase_1_bench_validation.pass_criteria: Median localization error <= 5mm AND 95th percentile <= predefined limit AND detection reliability >= threshold AND RF exposure requirement satisfied (SAR computed, not assumed)

phase_2_prototype.objective: Build functional prototype incorporating bench-validated mechanism

phase_3_relevant_environment.objective: Test in clinically relevant environment (cadaver, animal, or simulated)
